d: Atrium, with sumptuous temple, with the simulacrum of Mars, adorned with trophies, with Soldiers around it; there will be seen an altar with charms, and over them a unconscious horse, on which will be consecrated an ashtray, or either a knife, to the use of scitus, in the way of a saber; and near the same temple there will be a base, on which a golden basin, with the head of Cyrus, with an inscription at the same base. Tomiri, over triumphal chariot, pulled by Schiavi; assisted by Tigrane, Policare, Doraspe, Oronte, and Dorilla. A choir of Scythians will be called a chariot, which will make feast dances; and around it will be seen a choir of Custodians of the temple, one of which will carry a golden basin, with the head of Cyrus, which will be placed above the said base.
Meroe, in a dress of Egyptian guess: Pilgrim's orcone, is said aside.
Regio cameron, all adorned with vases of glossy crystal, where veggonsi transparir treasure of precious gems of Tomiri, with rich chair, and three other lower chairs. Polycare, and Oronte.
Oronte, and then Tomiri, and Dorilla.
Tomiri, Dorilla, and then Tigrane, Meroe, and Orcone.
Tigrane, Tomiri, and then Policare, and Doraspe.

Horrid, and mountain alpine pastures, to whose plants you will see trees fawning, and to its terrifying caves, in which there will be iron gates with various beasts inside; and in the middle a dark cave, with light at the bottom, from which the Scythians believe, that you go to the Elysian Fields. Meroe, and Orcone, dressed as a magician.
Meroe, dressed differently, with white veil, that cooks, appears in the cave, and sayings.
Orcone, dressed as a magician, who comes out yawning, as if he had risen to sleep; and then Dorilla.

Magnificent salon for vigils, and feasts, full of triumphal machines expressing the trio of Tomiri, with pompous throne in the middle, in which Tomiri will sit assisted by Tigrane, Policare, and Oronte, and choir of Scythians, performing, at their custom, and after finished, will say Tomiri:

Loco magnificent of delicious vegetables, where you will see several games of water, that go to form the bath for the queen, inside a closed car; with choir of Muti, that keep it. Oronte only with letter.
Choir of Paggi, which carry several basins with necessary things for the bathroom. Tomiri, courted by Tigrane, Policare, Doraspe, and Dorilla, is said.

The bathroom opens, and Tomiri comes out with the courtyard of Paggi, and Muti. He will bring a rest chair, and table, on which there will be different awards, that Tomiri will go dispensing to' Heads of his militia.
Meroe unnoticed, and then Tigrane, and said.
Orcone, dressed gallantly, in Paris, with wig and will bring two people, with a small table, on which there will be a galant box, and then Dorilla, dressed in German.
Public place of royal court, with throne, and several seats and steps, which correspond to various parts of the royal palace. Tomiri, Policare from two parts, without seeing each other.
Meroe, and then Doraspe, and sayings.
Tigrane's apartment with doors and doorman. Tigrane, and then Meroe.
Tomiri from behind a door, and sayings.
Orcone dressed as Dr. Graziano; and then Dorilla, dressed as Zaccagnino.

Grand imperial porch, which for several colonnades, introduces to various apartments, with a pillar, erected in the middle, and throne for Tomiri, who (to the use of the Scythians) will witness the death of Tigrane. Tomiri, and then Doraspe.
Tigrane led by Guards, and People, and sayings.
Meroe, with princess dress, Orcone, and sayings.
Oronte, with paper in hand, and sayings.
